title: Run the real-pi metering tests in CI (m4t displacement, 648 stream drain)
description:
TestPiDrainsTheGatewayStreamThroughTheMeteringOverride is the only end-to-end check that pi resolves the !command and that the account token displaces pi's stored key. It skips when pi is not on PATH, which includes every CI runner, so CI checks m4t only through a string match on the generated extension. Installing a pinned pi into the go test job would make the claim CI-verified.
